entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's wrong? Is it[n]Alibaba? Or Medjed?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We've gotta go to school for[n]make-up classes till August 1st!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It must be because we lost[n]so much class time due to the[n]Kamoshida incident.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit! There goes my free time!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait... Is that the only reason[n]you messaged us in here?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh...? Am I the only one[n]bothered by this shit...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose free time is[n]a valuable commodity.[n]Well, good night.
